open_points.subject: A08 rule 6 pre-send stale check scope
open_points.text: "fails one of rule 5's checks of the record itself — not those of the instance, which are A09 rule 6's own"
open_points.question: Exactly which rule-5 checks are re-evaluated before send as "record itself" (and therefore produce `binding_stale`) versus excluded from that set?
options: Only manifest-file and capability-entry checks that depend solely on manifest content
All rule-5 checks except the explicitly instance-related ones
A fixed enumerated subset that must be listed explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Only checks derivable from manifest record/capability content are re-run; proposal-shape checks are not.

open_points.subject: Required-header validity after binding acceptance
open_points.text: A08 rule 5 refuses required headers that "name one the kernel sets itself ... other than `host`"; A10 rule 1 says send-time instance checks detail names are only `instance_not_selected`, `instance_address_missing`, `required_header_repeated`, `plain_http_not_allowed`.
open_points.question: If manifest instance headers change later (without capability digest change) to include a forbidden kernel-set header name (e.g. `accept-encoding`, `content-type`) but not as a duplicate, which exact pre-send failure detail must be produced?
options: Introduce/use a distinct detail code for forbidden required header name
open_points.default_guess: Fail pre-send as `operation_failed` with `required_header_repeated` even though the name is forbidden rather than repeated.

open_points.subject: Manifest JSON duplicate-key handling
open_points.text: A08 rule 5 checks "is not valid JSON"; A01 rule 1 says duplicate keys are refused "where it enters"; A08 does not state duplicate-member handling for manifest files.
open_points.question: When a manifest service file parses but contains duplicate object member names, must proposal/send treat it as manifest mismatch, and at which check point?
options: Reject as manifest mismatch (equivalent to invalid JSON)
Reject only when duplicate appears inside the capability entry used for digest
open_points.default_guess: Reject as manifest mismatch at manifest-read time, same class as invalid JSON.

open_points.subject: A09 startup refusal depending on manifest required headers
open_points.text: "an installation whose credential header has ... the name of a required header ... refuses to start"
open_points.question: At startup, is the kernel required to read/validate manifest instance `required_headers` for all configured services to enforce this refusal, and what happens if some service manifest is unreadable though never used?
options: Eagerly validate all configured services at startup; any unreadable/invalid needed for this check blocks start
Apply this check lazily per invocation/proposal only
Validate only services that already have accepted bindings
open_points.default_guess: Validate lazily at first proposal/invocation; startup enforces only config-file-local checks.
